command.description: Command in the selected shell's syntax.

file_path.description: The path to the file to read.

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-based). Defaults to 1.

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read. Defaults to reading the entire file.

file_path.description: The path to the file to write.

content.description: The content to write to the file.

file_path.description: The path to the file to edit.

old_text.description: The exact text to find in the file.

new_text.description: The text to replace old_text with.

replace_all.description: If true, replace all occurrences. If false (default), replace only the first occurrence.

pattern.description: The glob pattern to match files against (e.g. '*.py', '**/*.ts').

path.description: The directory to search in. Defaults to the current working directory.

pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to search for.

path.description: The file or directory to search in. Defaults to the current working directory.

include.description: Glob pattern to filter which files to search (e.g. '*.py', '*.ts'). Defaults to all files.

case_insensitive.description: Whether to perform case-insensitive matching. Defaults to false.

max_length.description: Maximum number of characters to return. Defaults to 50000.

todos.description: The complete updated todo list. Each item must have 'content' (string) and 'status' (one of: pending, in_progress, completed).

question.description: The question to ask the user.
